description: Header file defining the ProofSourceChromium class, which implements the quic::ProofSource interface for QUIC protocol proof handling, including certificate and key initialization, proof generation, and TLS signature computation.

classes.name: ProofSourceChromium
classes.description: Implements the quic::ProofSource interface for handling QUIC cryptographic proof sources, including certificate and key management, proof generation, and TLS signature support.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the proof source with certificate chain, private key, and optional signed certificate timestamp from specified file paths.

methods.name: GetProof
methods.description: Generates a cryptographic proof for the specified server and client addresses, hostname, server config, and QUIC version, invoking the callback with the result.

methods.name: GetCertChain
methods.description: Retrieves the certificate chain associated with the proof source, indicating if the SNI matches.

methods.name: ComputeTlsSignature
methods.description: Computes a TLS signature over input data using the specified signature algorithm, invoking the callback with the result.

methods.name: SupportedTlsSignatureAlgorithms
methods.description: Returns a list of supported TLS signature algorithms.

methods.name: GetTicketCrypter
methods.description: Returns the current TicketCrypter used for encrypting tickets.

methods.name: SetTicketCrypter
methods.description: Sets the TicketCrypter for encrypting tickets.

methods.name: GetProofInner
methods.description: Internal method to generate proof with detailed parameters, used within GetProof.
